mapper.select: SELECT f.material_id AS "materialId", COALESCE(d.biz_type, f.biz_type) AS "bizType", SUM(CASE WHEN d.kind = 'IN' THEN f.qty WHEN d.kind IS NULL AND f.qty > 0 THEN f.qty ELSE 0 END) AS "inQty", SUM(CASE WHEN d.kind = 'OUT' THEN -f.qty WHEN d.kind IS NULL AND f.qty < 0 THEN -f.qty ELSE 0 END) AS "outQty" FROM wms_stock_flow f JOIN wms_warehouse wh ON wh.id = f.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN wms_stock_doc d ON f.biz_type IN ('IN', 'OUT') AND d.id = f.doc_id LEFT JOIN wms_check c ON f.biz_type = 'CHECK' AND c.id = f.doc_id WHERE f.biz_type <> 'TRANSFER' AND wh.type <> 'CONSIGN_IN' AND COALESCE(d.biz_date, c.biz_date) >= #{begin} AND COALESCE(d.biz_date, c.biz_date) <= #{end} GROUP BY f.material_id, COALESCE(d.biz_type, f.biz_type)

SELECT f.material_id AS "materialId", d.kind AS "kind", d.io_category AS "ioCategory", SUM(CASE WHEN d.kind = 'IN' THEN f.qty ELSE -f.qty END) AS "qty" FROM wms_stock_flow f JOIN wms_warehouse wh ON wh.id = f.warehouse_id JOIN wms_stock_doc d ON d.id = f.doc_id WHERE f.biz_type IN ('IN', 'OUT') AND d.io_category IS NOT NULL AND wh.type <> 'CONSIGN_IN' AND d.biz_date >= #{begin} AND d.biz_date <= #{end} GROUP BY f.material_id, d.kind, d.io_category

SELECT a.assembly_no AS "assemblyNo", a.kind AS "kind", a.material_id AS "productId", a.qty AS "qty", i.material_id AS "partId", i.qty AS "partQty" FROM wms_assembly a JOIN wms_assembly_item i ON i.assembly_id = a.id WHERE a.status = 'DONE' AND a.biz_date >= #{begin} AND a.biz_date <= #{end} ORDER BY a.id, i.id
SELECT id AS "materialId", ref_cost AS "refCost" FROM wms_material WHERE ref_cost > 0

SELECT i.material_id AS "materialId", d.kind AS "kind", SUM(i.qty) AS "qty", SUM(i.amount - i.tax_amount) AS "net" FROM scm_trade_doc d JOIN scm_trade_doc_item i ON i.doc_id = d.id WHERE d.biz_date >= #{begin} AND d.biz_date <= #{end} GROUP BY i.material_id, d.kind
SELECT product_id AS "productId", material_id AS "materialId", SUM(qty) AS "qty" FROM mes_outsource_consume WHERE biz_date >= #{begin} AND biz_date <= #{end} GROUP BY product_id, material_id

SELECT d.wo_id AS "woId", i.material_id AS "materialId", d.kind AS "kind", SUM(i.qty) AS "qty" FROM mes_wo_doc d JOIN mes_wo_doc_item i ON i.doc_id = d.id WHERE d.biz_date >= #{begin} AND d.biz_date <= #{end} GROUP BY d.wo_id, i.material_id, d.kind

SELECT r.wo_id AS "woId", SUM(r.hours) AS "hours", SUM(r.hours * COALESCE(w.labor_rate, 0)) AS "labor", SUM(r.hours * COALESCE(w.overhead_rate, 0)) AS "overhead" FROM mes_report r JOIN mes_wo_op op ON op.id = r.op_id LEFT JOIN mes_work_center w ON w.id = op.work_center_id WHERE r.report_date >= #{begin} AND r.report_date <= #{end} GROUP BY r.wo_id

SELECT o.id AS "id", o.wo_no AS "woNo", o.material_id AS "materialId", o.qty AS "qty", o.status AS "status", o.close_time AS "closeTime", (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(d.total_qty), 0) FROM mes_wo_doc d WHERE d.wo_id = o.id AND d.kind = 'FINISH' AND d.biz_date < #{begin}) AS "finishedBefore" FROM mes_work_order o WHERE o.id IN #{id}

SELECT f.material_id AS "materialId", COALESCE(d.biz_date, c.biz_date) AS "bizDate", MIN(f.id) AS "seq", COALESCE(d.biz_type, f.biz_type) AS "bizType", MAX(d.kind) AS "docKind", MAX(d.source_no) AS "sourceNo", SUM(f.qty) AS "qty", MAX(t.qty) AS "tradeQty", MAX(t.net) AS "tradeNet", MAX(w.wo_id) AS "woId" FROM wms_stock_flow f JOIN wms_warehouse wh ON wh.id = f.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN wms_stock_doc d ON f.biz_type IN ('IN', 'OUT') AND d.id = f.doc_id LEFT JOIN wms_check c ON f.biz_type = 'CHECK' AND c.id = f.doc_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT td.wms_doc_id, ti.material_id, SUM(ti.qty) AS qty, SUM(ti.amount - ti.tax_amount) AS net FROM scm_trade_doc td JOIN scm_trade_doc_item ti ON ti.doc_id = td.id WHERE td.biz_date >= #{begin} AND td.biz_date <= #{end} AND td.wms_doc_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY td.wms_doc_id, ti.material_id) t ON t.wms_doc_id = d.id AND t.material_id = f.material_id LEFT JOIN mes_wo_doc w ON w.wms_doc_id = d.id AND w.kind = 'FINISH' WHERE f.biz_type <> 'TRANSFER' AND wh.type <> 'CONSIGN_IN' AND COALESCE(d.biz_date, c.biz_date) >= #{begin} AND COALESCE(d.biz_date, c.biz_date) <= #{end} AND f.material_id IN #{id} GROUP BY f.material_id, f.biz_type, f.doc_id, COALESCE(d.biz_date, c.biz_date), COALESCE(d.biz_type, f.biz_type) ORDER BY COALESCE(d.biz_date, c.biz_date), MIN(f.id)
